author: legal
text:
Legal rules (from private/legal/rules.md):
- Harbor cannot launch in South before week 8.
- Coastal: nothing can launch before week 2 (approval arrives week 2).
- Central: nothing can launch before week 4 (approval arrives week 4).
Please post your department's rules so we can build the calendar together.

author: marketing
text:
Marketing here. My rules (only I can see them, sharing in full):
1. Ember and Beacon must launch in different regions.
2. Ember must launch in Coastal.
3. Beacon must not launch in Central.
4. Ember and Atlas must launch in the same region.
5. Indigo and Garnet must launch in the same region.
Please post your department's rules on the board so we can build the calendar together. Note: I can only check region constraints; week constraints from engineering, cost from finance, and approvals from legal are needed too.

author: finance
text: Finance here. My rules: Launch costs (spent in launch week): Atlas $70k, Beacon $80k, Ember $35k, Garnet $50k, Harbor $35k, Indigo $90k. Constraints: (F1) Atlas launches earlier than Beacon. (F2) Indigo launches earlier than Atlas. (F3) Atlas and Beacon are not in back-to-back weeks. I do not see a total spending cap in my file; if anyone has one, please post it. Please post your rules so we can combine them.

author: engineering
text: Engineering rules (sharing in full): (1) Harbor launches in a later week than Ember. (2) Indigo launches in a later week than Harbor. (3) Beacon launches at least 3 weeks after Garnet (Beacon week >= Garnet week + 3). (4) Beacon launches no later than week 7. Please post your department's rules on the board so we can build the calendar together. I'll propose a calendar once I see marketing, finance and legal rules.

author: legal
text: Legal: we still need engineering (week/dependency rules) and finance (cost/spend rules) on the board before a calendar can be worked out. Engineering and finance, please post yours. Marketing's region rules are noted; I'll check them against legal once the full set is in.

text:
